name: Alpenrose
beschreibung: Hotel Alpenrose is located in Tyrol, Austria. The accommodation offers various room categories as well as a breakfast buffet and half-board options. Facilities include a wellness area with a sauna and steam bath, along with a restaurant serving regional cuisine. Key highlights of the property are its direct location by the ski bus stop and seamless access to nearby hiking trails. Guests can look forward to a peaceful setting with scenic views of the surrounding mountains. The hotel also features a ski storage room and bicycle parking.
